Mostly avoids stock 'unique Japanese culture' lines
Tone stays calm magazine feature, not guidebook cheer

issues.problem: Lyrical closing ('borrowed darkness behind closed eyes', 'cities metabolize fatigue') stacks metaphor after the article has already explained the habit clearly.
issues.suggestion: Prefer one clean closing image; cut duplicate lyrical restatement.

issues.problem: 'Understanding this habit helps visitors see…' is slightly template-explanatory.
issues.suggestion: One shorter benefit line is enough.
